verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification SaaS with a public API, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions one. What it does document are adjacent developer surfaces: REST API endpoints, web and native SDKs, a JS SDK, a Postman collection, Zapier, and the Customer Portal. None of these is an official CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
